BiblicalUsage: To lift up in Daniel is the movement of a humbled king and a rising beast. Nebuchadnezzar lifts up his eyes to heaven at the end of his days, and his understanding returns to him; the first beast is lifted up from the earth and made to stand on its feet as a man.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe lifting the eyes to heaven is the first act of a restored mind — Nebuchadnezzar's reason came back when his eyes went up.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
